title: Video of Effector Gene Prediction symposium now available
summary: Get an overview of the complementary methods being developed by AMP-CMD consortium members for predicting which genes act as effectors for complex diseases and traits, in this video of a symposium held May 21, 2021.
bodyHtml: Get an overview of the complementary methods being developed by AMP-CMD consortium members for predicting which genes act as effectors for complex diseases and traits, in this video of a symposium held May 21, 2021. The meeting was chaired by Eric Fauman of Pfizer and features talks from Brent Richards, Jesse Engreitz, Melina Claussnitzer, Mark McCarthy, Anubha Mahajan, Noël Burtt, and Jason Flannick.
